WITH paintings,

User question: Which painting was created later, Head of a lion or Personification of the Church (Ecclesia)?

Query Generator's natural language explanation of its own query:
The query uses UNWIND to iterate over the two requested painting names, OPTIONAL MATCH to retrieve each painting (or null if missing), and collects the results. It then filters out entries with null creation years. If fewer than two valid years exist, it reports that comparison is impossible. Otherwise, it compares the two years and returns a clear statement of which painting was created later, or that they share the same year. This addresses the feedback by returning both paintings and their years, handling missing data, and explicitly indicating the comparison outcome.

Executed Cypher query:
WITH ['Head of a lion', 'Personification of the Church (Ecclesia)'] AS names
UNWIND names AS name
OPTIONAL MATCH (p:Painting {name: name})
WITH name, p
WITH collect({name: name, painting: p.name, year: p.creation_year}) AS paintings
WITH paintings,
     [x IN paintings WHERE x.year IS NOT NULL] AS with_year
RETURN paintings,
       CASE 
         WHEN size(with_year) < 2 THEN 'Cannot compare: missing data'
         WHEN with_year[0].year > with_year[1].year THEN with_year[0].painting + ' was created later'
         WHEN with_year[0].year < with_year[1].year THEN with_year[1].painting + ' was created later'
         ELSE 'Both created in the same year'
       END AS comparison

Query Generator's natural language explanation of its own query:
The query matches museums that have displayed paintings associated with an ArtMovement whose name contains 'italian renaissance' (case-insensitive). MATCH (m:Museum)<-[:displayedAt]-(p:Painting)-[:associatedWith]->(a:ArtMovement)

ORDER BY painting_count DESC
